realistic_gain: LB/private: 0. Operational: it removes a real restart hazard in the last ~27 h. Without it, a crashed or new session reads a stale E10 rule, a stale finals rule and the old retrain status from MEMORY. It then has to reconcile ~640 lines by hand, and meanwhile it could skip or waste an E10 slot or mis-state the finals to the user. Cost is ~10-15 min of session time.
